name: Sheetable – Display Datatable from Google Sheets
author: Sheetable

sections.description:
Sheetable makes it incredibly simple to display Google Sheets as WordPress tables—without using any Google API key, without server load, and without complex setup.

Sheetable uses client-side rendering + modern caching to deliver instant performance.

Paste your Google Sheet link → customize → insert shortcode → done.

🚀 What Makes Sheetable Different

Sheetable takes a modern approach to displaying Google Sheets data:

Key Features:

  • Ultra-lightweight (~500KB Whole Plugin)
  • Powered by SolidJS for instant rendering
  • Uses IndexedDB caching for repeat-load speed
  • No API key → no setup, no limits
  • Zero server-side processing
  • Handles large spreadsheets smoothly
  • Optimized for Core Web Vitals + Lighthouse 100/100
  • Loads within milliseconds

Modern performance—without complexity.

✨ Free Features

  • Unlimited tables
  • Unlimited Google Sheets
  • Unlimited rows & columns
  • Real-time search
  • Column sorting
  • Pagination
  • Manual refresh
  • Fully responsive layout
  • Supports links, images, text, numbers, dates, emojis
  • Show/hide table title & description
  • Row numbers display
  • Lightweight front-end (≈~500KB Whole Plugin)
  • Shortcode support
  • Interactive Gutenberg block editor

💼 Pro Features

  • Show/Hide header & footer
  • Auto-refresh with configurable intervals
  • Custom CSS editor
  • Full styling control (colors, fonts, borders, spacing)
  • Row & column offset
  • Limit rows & columns
  • Range selection (A1:F200 etc.)
  • Regex search (Regular Expression support)
  • Content protection (disable text selection & copy)
  • Export options:
    • Excel (XLSX)
    • CSV
    • TSV
    • PDF
    • HTML
    • Markdown
    • Copy to clipboard
    • Print
    • JSON

Perfect for professional dashboards or large datasets.

🎯 Perfect For

  • Pricing tables
  • Product catalogs
  • Inventory & stock lists
  • Employee directories
  • Schedules & routines
  • SEO comparison tables
  • Business & agency dashboards
  • Reports
  • Any data stored in Google Sheets

If your data is in Google Sheets, Sheetable displays it beautifully.

🧠 How It Works

  1. Set your Google Sheet to “Anyone with the link”
  2. Copy the sheet URL
  3. Paste it into Sheetable
  4. Customize (Pro unlocking advanced styling)
  5. Insert via shortcode or Gutenberg block editor anywhere

No API. No OAuth. No server load.

✔ SEO Benefits

  • Fully indexable HTML output
  • Lightweight → better Core Web Vitals
  • Faster mobile performance
  • Clean markup for search engines
  • Lower bounce rate → higher rankings

Sheetable helps both speed and SEO.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin or upload manually
  2. Activate it
  3. Go to Sheetable in WordPress Dashboard
  4. Paste your Google Sheet link
  5. Insert via shortcode or add the Sheetable block in Gutenberg editor
  6. Display in any post or page

Done.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google API key?

No! Sheetable works directly with public Google Sheets URLs. No API setup, no OAuth, no complicated configuration. Just paste your sheet link and go.

Will it slow down my WordPress site?

No. Sheetable is ultra-lightweight (only ~500KB) and uses client-side rendering. Everything loads in the visitor’s browser, which means zero server load and instant performance.

How many tables can I create?

Unlimited! Both free and pro versions let you create as many tables as you need with unlimited rows and columns.

Does it work with private Google Sheets?

No. Your Google Sheet must be set to “Anyone with the link can view” for Sheetable to access it. This is a Google Sheets permission setting.

How do I make my Google Sheet public?

  1. Open your Google Sheet
  2. Click the “Share” button (top right)
  3. Click “Change to anyone with the link”
  4. Set permission to “Viewer”
  5. Click “Done”

Does it support large spreadsheets?

Yes! Sheetable uses IndexedDB caching and SolidJS rendering to handle large spreadsheets smoothly. We’ve tested with sheets containing thousands of rows.

Can I customize the table design?

Yes. The free version includes basic display options. The Pro version adds full styling control including colors, fonts, borders, spacing, and custom CSS.

Does it support data export?

Yes, in the Pro version. Export formats include Excel (.xlsx), CSV, TSV, PDF, HTML, Markdown, JSON, Print, and Copy to Clipboard.

Does the table auto-refresh when I update my Google Sheet?

Yes, with the Pro version. You can set automatic refresh intervals or provide a manual refresh button for users.

Can I sort and search the data?

Yes! The free version includes real-time search and column sorting. The Pro version adds regex search for advanced pattern matching.

Is the table mobile-responsive?

Absolutely! All tables are fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices, tablets, and desktops.

Can visitors copy data from the table?

By default, yes. The Pro version includes a content protection feature that disables text selection and copying if needed.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

Free includes unlimited tables, search, sorting, pagination, and basic display. Pro adds advanced controls (header/footer toggle, offsets, ranges), all export formats, regex search, auto-refresh, full styling, and content protection.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Pro version is coming soon! You’ll be notified automatically when it becomes available through your WordPress dashboard updates.
